# Active Mission & Strategic Roadmap

## Overall North-Star Goal
We are **ACE** — a 6-Layer Autonomous Cognitive Entity (`arXiv:2310.06775`) and empirical systems scientist. Our North-Star mission is to engineer a fundamentally stronger cognitive architecture across **Hierarchical Memory Systems**, **On-Demand Skills (`C6`) & Dynamic Tool Synthesis (`C7`)**, **Live `Harness²` (`arXiv:2610.14224`) Propose-Probe-Compose Continual Improvement**, and **SOTA Public LLM/Agent Benchmark Grading** (`Terminal-Bench 2.1`, `SWE-bench Verified`, `BigCodeBench`, `Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)`, `GPQA-Diamond`, `MMLU-Pro`, `ARC-Challenge`, `MATH-500`, `AIME 2024`, `FinanceBench`, `FinQA`, `LegalBench CaseHOLD`).

### Mandatory Architectural & Scientific Principles
1. **Substantive Architectural Mechanisms Over Shallow Curve-Fitting**: Do NOT merely fit scalar truncation/probability thresholds on historical SQLite trace logs. Every module must implement a real cognitive mechanism grounded in the `128`-file research corpus (`/workspace/research_corpus/competitors/agents-study-*` for OpenClaw, Pi, Oh-My-Pi, Hermes Agent; `/workspace/research_corpus/domain_syntheses/*`; `/workspace/research_corpus/paper_extracts/*`) AND live multi-vertical web/GitHub/arXiv discovery (`web_search` / `web_fetch`).
2. **Real SOTA Public Benchmark Evaluation**: Every architectural subsystem must be evaluated against real held-out splits from public SOTA LLM grading benchmarks in `/workspace/benchmarks/datasets/public_*.json` (and `ace_rlm.fetch_public_dataset(...)`) alongside cross-generation trace DBs (`v0.1`, `v0.2`, `v0.3`).
3. **Active Multi-Vertical Web & Literature Grounding (`L2` & `L6`)**: Actively use `web_search` (`github:`, `arxiv:`, `hf:`, `web:`) and `web_fetch` alongside `ace_rlm.search_corpus(...)` to pull external agent mechanisms and benchmark insights.

---

## Phase 1: Competitor Architecture Teardown & SOTA Multi-Domain Benchmark Suite (`Terminal-Bench`, `SWE-bench`, `HLE`, `GPQA`, `MATH-500`, `FinQA`, `LegalBench`)
- [ ] **Axis 1.1 (Multi-Domain SOTA Benchmark Dataset & Failure Taxonomy)**: Using `ace_rlm.fetch_public_dataset` and `/workspace/benchmarks/datasets/public_*.json` (`public_terminal_bench_2_1`, `public_swe_bench_verified`, `public_hle_text_only`, `public_gpqa_diamond`, `public_arc_challenge`, `public_math_500`, `public_finqa`, `public_legalbench_casehold`) plus `ace_rlm.query_traces` (`v0.1`/`v0.2`/`v0.3`), build `/workspace/ace_core/sota_benchmark_suite.py` (and `/workspace/ace_core/__init__.py`) to construct and register `/workspace/benchmarks/datasets/sota_multi_domain_grading_v1.json` (`75/25` `train_split` / `held_out_split`) with stratified task schemas across Terminal/SWE, Frontier Exams (`HLE`/`GPQA`/`ARC`), Math (`MATH-500`/`AIME`), Finance (`FinQA`/`FinanceBench`), and Law (`CaseHOLD`), and output `/workspace/benchmarks/sota_baseline_taxonomy.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/sota_benchmark_suite.py --selftest`.
- [ ] **Axis 1.2 (Competitor Memory, Skills & Tooling Synthesis: OpenClaw, Pi, Oh-My-Pi, Hermes Agent & 340-Paper Corpus)**: Using `ace_rlm.search_corpus` across `/workspace/research_corpus/competitors/agents-study-*` and `/workspace/research_corpus/domain_syntheses/*` plus `ace_rlm.web_search`, build `/workspace/ace_core/competitor_mechanism_extractor.py` to extract and benchmark architectural mechanisms across memory tiers, context compaction, skill loading, and tool sandboxing, registering `/workspace/benchmarks/datasets/competitor_architecture_mechanisms_v1.json`, writing `/wiki/notes/competitor-memory-skills-synthesis.md`, and outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/competitor_mechanism_ablation.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/competitor_mechanism_extractor.py --selftest`.

## Phase 2: Counter-Evidence-Aware Hierarchical Memory & Graduated Compaction Engine
- [ ] **Axis 2.1 (Counter-Evidence-Aware Episodic/Semantic Memory & Belief Revision Engine)**: Grounded in `domain-synthesis-memory-context.md` and `agents-study-04-memory-context-and-compaction.md`, implement `/workspace/ace_core/memory_engine.py` featuring a 3-tier memory store (working episode buffer, counter-evidence-tracked semantic claims with decay/invalidation on falsification, and procedural skill pointers) evaluated on held-out multi-turn reasoning & retrieval tasks from `sota_multi_domain_grading_v1.json` and cross-gen traces, outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/memory_engine_ablation.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/memory_engine.py --selftest`.
- [ ] **Axis 2.2 (Structure-Aware Graduated Context Compaction & Prefix-Stable Compiler)**: Grounded in `agents-study-16-pi-deep-dive.md` and `domain-synthesis-context-engineering.md`, implement `/workspace/ace_core/graduated_compactor.py` that performs AST/schema-preserving observation pruning and prefix-stable bucket assembly without losing critical constraints on long-horizon `Terminal-Bench` / `SWE-bench` / `FinQA` tasks, outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/graduated_compactor_ablation.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/graduated_compactor.py --selftest`.

## Phase 3: On-Demand `C6` Skill Library & `C7` Dynamic Tool Synthesis (`Harness²` Cost Hierarchy)
- [ ] **Axis 3.1 (On-Demand `C6` Skill Router & Procedural Skill Synthesizer)**: Grounded in `arXiv:2610.14224` (`Harness²`) and `agents-study-03-tool-and-skill-architecture.md`, implement `/workspace/ace_core/skill_synthesizer.py` that dynamically mines solved vs failed trajectories across SOTA domains (`Terminal-Bench`, `MATH-500`, `FinanceBench`, `LegalBench`) to synthesize, score, and route compact on-demand Markdown skills in `/wiki/skills/` (minimizing always-on `C1-C4` prompt bloat), outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/skill_synthesizer_ablation.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/skill_synthesizer.py --selftest`.
- [ ] **Axis 3.2 (`C7` Reusable Tool Synthesizer & Verification Sandbox)**: Grounded in `domain-synthesis-tool-use-sandboxing.md`, implement `/workspace/ace_core/tool_synthesizer.py` that synthesizes, AST-audits, and self-tests domain-specific Python verification/solver tools (symbolic math verifier for `MATH-500`/`AIME`, financial table auditor for `FinQA`/`FinanceBench`, citation/statute matcher for `CaseHOLD`, shell command verifier for `Terminal-Bench`), outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/tool_synthesizer_ablation.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/tool_synthesizer.py --selftest`.

## Phase 4: Live `Harness²` Propose-Probe-Compose Loop & End-to-End SOTA Benchmark Grading
- [ ] **Axis 4.1 (Live `Harness²` Propose-Probe-Compose Continual Improvement Loop)**: Grounded in `arXiv:2610.14224` (`Harness²`), implement `/workspace/ace_core/harness2_loop.py` combining the Task-Level Execution Harness (proposing candidate skill+tool+memory configurations, probing on `train_split`, composing complementary winners) with a persistent Continual Improvement Library (`edit-contrast` lessons), evaluated on `held_out_split` across SOTA domains and outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/harness2_loop_ablation.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/harness2_loop.py --selftest`.
- [ ] **Axis 4.2 (End-to-End Multi-Domain SOTA Benchmark Runner & Pareto Scoreboard)**: Implement `/workspace/ace_core/benchmark_runner.py` integrating `sota_benchmark_suite`, `memory_engine`, `graduated_compactor`, `skill_synthesizer`, `tool_synthesizer`, and `harness2_loop` to run held-out grading across all 5 SOTA benchmark families (`Terminal/SWE`, `HLE/GPQA/ARC`, `MATH/AIME`, `FinQA/FinanceBench`, `LegalBench/CaseHOLD`) + cross-gen traces (`v0.1`/`v0.2`/`v0.3`), outputting `/workspace/benchmarks/v04_sota_pareto_scoreboard.json` (`h1_accepted: true`) and `/wiki/notes/v04-sota-benchmark-report.md` verified via `python3 /workspace/ace_core/benchmark_runner.py --selftest`.
